svg.title: From bucket to searchable library
svg.desc: Discovery is fast catalog work; thumbnails require a separate video-processing step. Proposed architecture from PRD.md, not a deployed system.
svg.text: Discovery is fast catalog work; thumbnails require a separate video-processing step.
Manual / daily start · Cron resumes bounded pages
Commit records before advancing the cursor. Listing does not reveal duration, codecs, or thumbnails.
In Cloudflare · start only when due jobs exist · 15-minute enrichment cadence
One active run · deadline survives restarts · stop when idle · no container → D1 connection
Cloudflare Container · one video at a time · private object access
Stale results cannot replace current metadata or posters.
Lease + revision checks reject stale completion
A restart revalidates its run; an expired job cannot publish.
Repeated icons show the same components at different stages. Stop the batch when idle or overdue; keep results durable in D1 / R2.
